programme.title: Wallace 's Gromit
programme.desc: Tha uan beag gleusda a' dèanamh a ghnothaich air teicheadh bho làraidh nam mèirlich 's e a dèanamh a shlighe gu taigh Wallace 's Gromit far a bheil e ga dhèanamh fhèin gu math cofhartail. Ge-tà, chan eil fada gus an tuig na mèirlich cà bheil an trusdar beag cloimhteach 's tha trioblaid gu leòr a gabhail àite nuair a thig iad air a thoir. Tha cuisean a' fàs na duilghe buileach 's Wallace ann an gaol le tè dha na mèirlich 's Gromit air a chur dhan phrìosan. An tig ciall 's saorsa thuca ann an àm airson an t-uan 's an còrr de na caoraich a shàbhaladh bhon inneal pronnaidh? A wise little sheep manages to escape the rustling truck and make his way to Wallace and Gromit's house, where he and his appetite make themselves quite at home. However, it doesn't take the rustlers long to discover his whereabouts and plenty of trouble ensues when they attempt to get him back. Things are further complicated when Wallace falls in love with one half of the rustling duo and Gromit is wrongly thrown in jail by the other. Will it all be resolved in time for them to rescue their little wooly visitor and the rest of the flock from the mincing machine?

programme.title: Abigail
programme.desc: Airson treat sgoinneil airson brunch, tha Abigail a’ dèanamh Smoothie le Deit is Teòclaid. Tha e math ’s tha e math dhut, agus e air a stobhadh le maitheas an t-samhraidh. For a splendid brunch treat, Abigail makes a date and chocolate smoothie. It's wholesome and tasty, as well as being packed with summer goodness. In Gaelic with English subtitles.

programme.title: Rudan Beaga Bòidheach/Life’s Little Things
programme.desc: Tha Niamh NicFhionghain a’ coinneachadh daoine òga eile gus rudan beaga fheuchainn a tha a’ toirt toileachas dhaibh. Bho Iòga air mullach cnoc, a bhith a’ sgrìobhadh bàrdachd, gu furachas, dòigh-beatha a’ bhana-campachaidh no a bhith a’ cluich camanachd – tha tòrr ann air an urrainn dhut a bhith taingeil an uair a tha thu air a’ bhlàr a-muigh. Skye digital creator Niamh Mackinnon meets other young people to try out the different little activities that spark joy for them. From hilltop yoga, writing poems, mindfulness, campervan life to playing shinty - there’s so much to appreciate when you just get out there. In Gaelic with English subtitles.

programme.title: Somhairle Spins
programme.desc: Tha Somhairle agus athair a’ cur an dàimh a th’aca gu deuchainn air Ìle agus Diùra, le aon teanta bheag, dà stòbha campachaidh agus aon bhaidhsagal airson dithis! Somhairle and his dad test the limits of their relationship on Islay and Jura - equipped with one small tent, two camping stoves and a bicycle made for two!

programme.title: An Là
programme.desc: Naidheachdan ionadail, nàiseanta is eadar-nàiseanta gach là cuide ri fiosrachadh coimhearsnachd bho BBC ALBA. Local, national and international news and information from BBC ALBA.

programme.title: Geamaichean a' Cho-fhlaitheis Glaschu 2026/Commonwealth Games Glasgow 2026
programme.desc: Spòrs beò agus geàrr-chunntasan an latha bho Glaschu 2026. Air a lìbhrigeadh le Derek ‘Pluto’ Moireach agus sgioba aithris BBC ALBA. Live sporting action and highlights from Glasgow 2026. Presented by Derek ‘Pluto’ Murray and BBC ALBA’s commentary team.

programme.title: Belladrum
programme.desc: Tha Fiona NicChoinnich is Niall Iain Dòmhnallach a’ toirt thugainn prògram bhon dàrna latha de Belladrum 2026. Chuir an fhèis fàilte air sàr-luchd-ciùil chun na Gàidhealtachd, agus anns a’ phrògram seo, tha taisbeanaidhean beothail bho Rizzle Kicks, Scouting For Girls, Nathan Carter agus Brooke Combe. Fiona MacKenzie and Niall Iain Macdonald present coverage from the second day of Belladrum 2026. The festival welcomes an incredible musical line-up to the Scottish Highlands, and this programme features performances from Rizzle Kicks, Scouting For Girls, Nathan Carter and Brooke Combe.

programme.title: Na Sgiobairean mu Dheireadh/The Last Captains
programme.desc: Tha iasgairean giomach Eileanan Magdalen gan slaiceadh le gèiltean, a’ dèanamh blàr-catha den mhuir far a bheil gach cliabh ag adhbharachadh cunnart. Gale-force winds hammer lobster captains on the Magdalen Islands, turning the sea into a battleground where every trap is a risk. Dubbed in Gaelic with English subtitles

programme.title: Samhradh air Sàl
programme.desc: Angus Mackay is joined by close friend Finlay Macleod from Scalpay for the final fishing trip of the season. With summer fading, the environment looks very different as the purple heather really comes to the fore. Tracked by the golden eagle, they sail north to the hamlet of Calbost to take advantage of the shelter offered by its bay on a less than optimal day. As the duo fish in the bay, they ponder the extremes of the sea - its matchless beauty and its mortal danger. Anns a’ phrògram mu dheireadh san t-sreath, tha Fionnlagh MacLeòid à Sgalpaigh, còmhla ri Aonghas airson an turas iasgaich mu dheireadh den t-seusan. Leis an samhradh a’ tighinn gu crìoch, tha an àrainneachd a’ coimhead gu math eadar-dhealaichte, ‘s am fraoch purpaidh a’ tighinn am follais. Air an leantainn le iolaire-bhuidhe, seòlaidh iad gu tuath, gu Calbost gus beagan fasgadh fhaighinn sa bhàgh, air latha meadhanach grod. Fhad ’s a tha iad ag iasgach, tha iad a’ meòrachadh air an dà chuid cunnart agus bòidhchead na mara.

programme.title: Top of the Pops

programme.title: Top of the Pops

programme.title: Top of the Pops
programme.desc: Mike Read and Janice Long present another edition of the pop chart programme, first broadcast on 28 July 1983. Featuring KC and the Sunshine Band, Elvis Costello and the Attractions, The Lotus Eaters and Bananarama.

programme.title: Natural World
programme.desc: The ruined temples of Sri Lanka are home to Gremlin, a baby toque macaque. With predators nearby and a rivalry with other monkeys brewing, she must quickly learn how to survive.

programme.title: Life on Earth
programme.desc: David Attenborough looks at the history of reptiles, the first back-boned creatures to solve the problems of living high and dry on the land. Their waterproofed skin and sealed eggs enabled the mighty reptiles to rule the world.

programme.title: Remembers...
programme.desc: Monty Don looks back on the remarkable career of TV gardener Geoff Hamilton, who led Gardeners’ World for 16 years, until his untimely death in 1996.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Now that rambling roses have finished flowering, Monty turns his attention to pruning and tying in new growth for a good display next year. On the 20th anniversary of the death of Geoff Hamilton, Adam Frost returns to the famous Gardeners' World location, Barnsdale, to pay tribute and to revisit some of his own early gardening memories. And we travel to Abergavenny to visit the garden of a sweet pea enthusiast, to get her top tips for growing the best blooms.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Geoff Hamilton, Margaret Waddy and John Kelly present a programme from Barnsdale. Early August is an ideal time for propagation, and with this in mind, the team shows how to take softwood and semi-ripe cuttings and how to build a do-it-yourself propagator. Fuchsia expert John Smith joins the team, while in the vegetable area, attention turns to unusual vegetables such as pak choi, saladisi and chrysanthemum.

programme.title: Geoff Hamilton: A Man and His Garden
programme.desc: First shown in 1998 as a tribute to TV gardener Geoff Hamilton, this programme tells the history of the gardens he created in Barnsdale in Leicestershire.

programme.title: The Sentinels
programme.desc: The Sentinels experience a serious setback while en route to free Mazauric. Eventually, the mission resumes, as they unwittingly edge nearer to the Übermensch. At the laboratory, Marthe carries out initial testing on a new recruit. Aria, a young woman who had been sentenced to death, receives her first dose of Dyxenal. In French and German with English subtitles.

programme.title: The Sentinels
programme.desc: Irène is forced to halt her investigation when the risk proves too great. With Gabriel and Djibouti captured, how will the Sentinels regroup to take on their most formidable foe yet? In French and German with English subtitles.

programme.title: Keeping Up Appearances
programme.desc: When Hyacinth gets passionate about art, Daddy decides to join the Foreign Legion. Meanwhile, Mr Finchley has desires of his own for Rose.

programme.title: One Foot in the Grave
programme.desc: Victor is unable to sleep, and things get so desperate that he contemplates opening Ronnie and Mildred's Christmas present from last year.

programme.title: Dangerous Earth
programme.desc: Dr Helen Czerski examines the hottest natural phenomenon on the planet - lightning. Bolts of lightning five times hotter than the surface of the sun strike our planet over three million times every day - and yet we still know little about this deadly force of nature. Now, specialist photography is revealing how lightning travels through the air, high-speed cameras are unlocking the secrets of upward lightning that's triggered by our urban landscapes, and scientific expeditions are capturing rare images of intense electrical discharges over 80 kilometres wide.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Now that rambling roses have finished flowering, Monty turns his attention to pruning and tying in new growth for a good display next year. On the 20th anniversary of the death of Geoff Hamilton, Adam Frost returns to the famous Gardeners' World location, Barnsdale, to pay tribute and to revisit some of his own early gardening memories. And we travel to Abergavenny to visit the garden of a sweet pea enthusiast, to get her top tips for growing the best blooms.

programme.desc: Yasmin Morgan-Griffiths finds out how new technologies are being used to measure the world's forests in more detail than ever before. Suranjana Tewari takes us inside a robotics factory in Beijing. Joe Tidy has exclusive access to the hacker rehab programme steering teenagers away from cybercrime. And we meet the creator of an AI-powered sign language platform in Kenya.

programme.desc: The latest news from the BBC.

programme.title: Clive Myrie’s Caribbean Adventure
programme.desc: For 11 months of the year, the city of La Vega is well off the tourist track. But each February, it bursts into life. Over the course of four weekends, it’s loud, hot and colourful as visitors from all over the world arrive to join in the famous street carnivals. Clive is in the party mood and throws himself into the fun. He stocks up on local sweet treats, meets talented mask makers and prepares outrageous costumes before joining the parade in full costume.

programme.title: Global Eye
programme.desc: A weekly programme from the BBC World Service bringing forensic journalism from all corners of the world by BBC Eye, the World Service's critically acclaimed investigative unit, and featuring expert global correspondents getting to the heart of the biggest international stories. This week, BBC Eye talks to Ukrainians civilians abused in Russian-occupied Ukraine and tracks down the prison guards, officials and soldiers likely responsible. And Kurumi Mori explores a question now shaping the future of Japan: as the country relies more on foreign workers, can it embrace greater diversity without losing what it means to be Japanese?

programme.title: The Media Show
programme.desc: The Economist's interview with Elon Musk attracted global attention before Musk then described interviewer Zanny Minton Beddoes as a 'traitor to the West'. The interview followed 90 minutes of conversation for The Insider, The Economist's video series. Zanny Minton Beddoes, Editor-in-Chief of The Economist, explains how the interview came about and the reaction after it was published. programme.title: AI Decoded
programme.desc: AI Decoded asks whether the AI revolution is delivering on its promises. Companies and organisations are spending vast sums on artificial intelligence after being promised AI will transform productivity, improve efficiency and unlock entirely new ways of working. Yet a growing number of investors and analysts are asking a simple question: where's the proof? Research suggests only a small percentage of enterprise AI projects are producing measurable value. Businesses have bought the software, invested in licences and launched pilot projects, but many are still struggling to turn that investment into meaningful results. So is AI failing to live up to expectations? Or are companies simply approaching adoption the wrong way.

Joining them in the studio are radio host Chloe Burrows and rapper Aitch, Gladiators stars Sabre and Nitro, and Emmerdale actors Lisa Riley and Dominic Brunt. Will chart knowledge or star power shine brightest as they compete to win £10,000 for a good cause? Play along and shout the answers at the telly!

programme.title: Alan Carr's Picture Slam
programme.desc: Comedian Alan Carr returns to host the fun and frantic quiz show where every question is a picture and every picture is worth cash. They could be anything from famous faces, places, products or logos, and teams need to name them all for a Picture Slam. Playing this time are friends Desiree and Eliza from Birmingham, friends Jax and Des from Lancashire, and Josh and Emma, a couple from Cardiff. They battle it out across four rounds, shouting out their answers and building their banks. But only one team can make it to the final Super Slam for the chance to win £10,000.

programme.title: Michael McIntyre's Big Show
programme.desc: BAFTA award-winning comedian Michael McIntyre hosts his Big Show, an unmissable night of family entertainment at London's prestigious Theatre Royal Drury Lane. Holly Willoughby plays new game Remember Me, Perrie Edwards is awoken for an epic Midnight Gameshow, McFly v Busted give a spectacular performance, and a heartwarming Unexpected Star of the Show gets the surprise of their life.

programme.title: Pointless Celebrities
programme.desc: A celebrity special edition of the general knowledge quiz in which four teams try to come up with the answers that no-one else could think of. Presented by Alexander Armstrong and co-host Richard Osman and featuring James Jordan, Gemma Collins, Brian McFadden, Ionica Adriana, Melvin Odoom, Hayley Hasselhoff, Charlie Hedges and Melinda Messenger.

programme.title: How Are You? It's Alan (Partridge)
programme.desc: Can nature heal a troubled mind? Alone in the Peaks with only a selfie stick, Alan draws on the teat of Mother Nature and unlocks a heroic side some people doubted he ever had.

programme.title: Radio 1 Dance Weekend
programme.desc: Scottish DJ, producer and global superstar Calvin Harris returns home for a hugely anticipated show, live from Glasgow’s legendary Hampden Park. Celebrating an extraordinary 20-year career, the prolific hitmaker has amassed over 56 billion streams, won multiple awards and boasts 11 UK number one singles, making him the dance act with the most chart-topping records in history. Just 20 years after playing his first ever gig to around 300 people at Glasgow's King Tut's Wah Wah Hut, the Dumfries-born artist transforms the country's national stadium into a giant open-air club. He performs a career-spanning set packed with era-defining anthems, spectacular production and euphoric moments for more than 50,000 fans, his biggest Scottish crowd to date.

programme.title: Anna Haugh’s Big Irish Food Tour
programme.desc: Often called Ireland's hidden gem, Sligo is a small county full of culinary delights. Father Ted actor Pauline McLynn is excited to show Anna around. Exploring Sligo Bay, Anna learns about lobster fishing and cooks up a meal to share with local fishermen. Pauline talks about her fond childhood memories of beach picnics with her father in Strandhill, before Anna takes pescatarian Pauline to an oyster farm, where the pair are put to work during the busy summer season.

programme.title: Homes Under the Hammer
programme.desc: A scenic plot of land in Staffordshire by the water has Dion beaming with enthusiasm, while Jacqui is trying to crack the code of a safe left behind in a house in Norfolk. Great minds think alike as Martin and the new owner of a house in south Wales have the same ideas on how to improve the layout.

programme.title: Radio 1 Dance Weekend
programme.desc: Scottish DJ, producer and global superstar Calvin Harris returns home for a hugely anticipated show, live from Glasgow’s legendary Hampden Park. Celebrating an extraordinary 20-year career, the prolific hitmaker has amassed over 56 billion streams, won multiple awards and boasts 11 UK number one singles, making him the dance act with the most chart-topping records in history. Just 20 years after playing his first ever gig to around 300 people at Glasgow's King Tut's Wah Wah Hut, the Dumfries-born artist transforms the country's national stadium into a giant open-air club. He performs a career-spanning set packed with era-defining anthems, spectacular production and euphoric moments for more than 50,000 fans, his biggest Scottish crowd to date.

programme.desc: Often called Ireland's hidden gem, Sligo is a small county full of culinary delights. Father Ted actor Pauline McLynn is excited to show Anna around. programme.title: Radio 1 Dance Weekend
programme.desc: Scottish DJ, producer and global superstar Calvin Harris returns home for a hugely anticipated show, live from Glasgow’s legendary Hampden Park. Celebrating an extraordinary 20-year career, the prolific hitmaker has amassed over 56 billion streams, won multiple awards and boasts 11 UK number one singles, making him the dance act with the most chart-topping records in history. Just 20 years after playing his first ever gig to around 300 people at Glasgow's King Tut's Wah Wah Hut, the Dumfries-born artist transforms the country's national stadium into a giant open-air club. He performs a career-spanning set packed with era-defining anthems, spectacular production and euphoric moments for more than 50,000 fans, his biggest Scottish crowd to date.

programme.title: Anna Haugh’s Big Irish Food Tour
programme.desc: Often called Ireland's hidden gem, Sligo is a small county full of culinary delights. Father Ted actor Pauline McLynn is excited to show Anna around. Exploring Sligo Bay, Anna learns about lobster fishing and cooks up a meal to share with local fishermen. Pauline talks about her fond childhood memories of beach picnics with her father in Strandhill, before Anna takes pescatarian Pauline to an oyster farm, where the pair are put to work during the busy summer season.

programme.title: Doctor Who (2005–2022)
programme.desc: If you took everything from him, betrayed him, trapped him, and broke both his hearts... how far might the Doctor go? programme.title: Not Going Out
programme.desc: To take advantage of three free tickets to Adventure Canyon Theme Park, Lee takes Mollie out of school for a day and gets into trouble with the new head teacher, Miss Anstis. programme.title: Not Going Out
programme.desc: Lee wakes up inside a coffin and can't remember how he got there, until a phone call from Lucy reminds him what he’d been doing that afternoon. Now all he needs to do is keep Lucy in the dark as to his exact location and work out how to escape.

programme.title: Mrs Brown's Boys
programme.desc: There is bickering aplenty in the Brown household, as Rory and Dino are on the rocks and Agnes and Betty rub each other up the wrong way. With Maria about to give birth, Cathy convinces Agnes to build bridges and invite Maria's mother Hillary out for dinner. However, the night comes to an abrupt end when Maria goes into labour. Can the family get Maria to the hospital in time?

programme.title: Mrs Brown's Boys
programme.desc: After a spate of burglaries in Finglas, Agnes asks Buster Brady to fit a new alarm system. Unfortunately there are a few teething problems with Buster's state-of-the-art technology. Determined to help son Dermot set up a new business, Agnes must face old rival Hillary Nicholson in the poker final. Meanwhile, Agnes's new chair turns out to be comfier than she could ever have imagined...

programme.title: Ghosts Australia
programme.desc: The Australian version of the hit UK series. When city couple Kate and Sean inherit Ramshead Manor, a run-down country estate, they see it as a sign for a fresh new start. But after Kate has a near-death experience, she gains the ability to see and hear ghosts – and discovers there are several living in the mansion. Kate must navigate the ghosts' issues while trying to start a hotel business with Sean, who remains unable to see them.

programme.title: Schitt's Creek
programme.desc: In the hope of making some quick money, Johnny enters the illegal raw milk business, but things quickly take a turn for the worse when Alexis is left in charge of ordering the supply. Moira, feeling disconnected from the voting public, attempts to bond with some of the locals. David is drawn into advising Moira’s competitor Jocelyn against his better judgement.

programme.title: Schitt's Creek
programme.desc: Talk of an online scandal has Moira expecting salacious photos from her past to have surfaced to sully her election campaign. Johnny’s money problems become overwhelming, so he seeks emergency help from an unlikely source, his son, while Alexis gets an unexpected offer of employment. [adapted from distributor's info]

programme.title: Bluestone 42

programme.title: The Weasy Family
programme.desc: Sunny and Spicy are happily playing with bubbles until Weasy shows up and pops them - he's ruining their game! It's time to teach him a lesson.

programme.title: Super Happy Magic Forest
programme.desc: The heroes have found the Wishing Trident, which will help them on their quest to prevent the summoning of the legendary two-headed dragon, Iceburn. Now the heroes are left to defeat the dragon using only one wish, a never-ending ice cream cone (with sprinkles) and a giant spicy sausage hat!

programme.desc: The Lemmings activate the air conditioner's AI, causing it to fall in love with the fridge

programme.title: Duck and Frog

programme.title: Pokémon Horizons
programme.desc: Liko, Zirc and Onia find Amethio living on a deserted island.

programme.title: Winx Club - The Magic Is Back
programme.desc: Despite Faragonda sealing their powers away, the Winx are sent on a challenging camping trip in the Dark Forest. Meanwhile, Vexius seizes the opportunity to capture Bloom’s Dragon Flame.

programme.title: The Next Step: Cheer
programme.desc: When a legendary coach abruptly leaves a highly successful cheerleading gym, the team are left in disarray, The Next Step’s Kenzie steps in to take over what’s left of the team, desperate to prove she is more than just a dancer, and that she can build this rag-tag group of athletes into a contender for nationals.

programme.title: Newsround
programme.desc: Topical news magazine for children.

programme.title: The Lady Grace Mysteries
programme.desc: When the Crown of St Benedict is stolen from a locked and guarded room in the court of Queen Elizabeth I, Lady Grace sets out to solve the mystery!

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: As summer reaches its peak, Monty plans ahead, and after weeks of soaring temperatures, he’s got his work cut out refreshing the borders with a selection of late-summer perennials. He also has a rambling rose to tackle, and in the veg garden, the cleared beds are quickly being re-sown with crops for future harvests. Thirty years after the death of gardening legend Geoff Hamilton, Adam Frost makes a deeply personal visit to Barnsdale and reflects on the man whose huge influence helped shape both his career and love of horticulture. Carol Klein continues her fascinating journey into the secret life of plants. Exploring cutting-edge science, she discovers how vast networks of underground microbes work in partnership with plant roots, revealing the extraordinary hidden world beneath the earth. There’s an award-winning grower whose passion for gladioli has led to a collection of more than 1,800 spectacular blooms. Plus a visit to a remarkable Balinese-inspired tropical paradise nestled on the edge of the Brecon Beacons.

programme.title: On the Waterfront
programme.desc: Oscar-winning drama. A one-time boxing hopeful learns about responsibility through his love for the sister of a murdered docker. Music by Leonard Bernstein.

programme.title: The Great British Sewing Bee
programme.desc: It’s week 3, and it's time for Reduce, Reuse, Recycle. Presenter Sophie Willan, alongside judges Patrick Grant and Esme Young, takes the fight to fast fashion with three challenges focused on the environment and sustainability. First up, in the Pattern Challenge, it’s another sewing bee first as the sewers are tasked with creating pants from old T-shirts. However, they are not asked to make just one pair - they have to make three. This challenge tests not only their technical skill but also their consistency. Then, Patrick and Esme take a trip to a store of waste destined for landfill to hand-pick the raw materials for the Transformation Challenge. Finally, the sewers get protesting as they make outfits with an environmental message made to measure their models.

programme.title: A Cook Abroad
programme.desc: Cook and food writer Rachel Khoo heads to Malaysia, home of her extended family, to explore one of the world's most exciting cuisines. From the tropical shores of a remote fishing village to a foraged feast deep in the jungle, Rachel travels across this multicultural country to find out whether good food can unite a nation. On this journey of discovery Rachel delves deep into her own family heritage. Starting in the country's capital, Kuala Lumpur, she gets her first insights into Malaysian food and culture from family members she hasn't seen since childhood. In her dad's old school she meets cooks and students and begins to find out why Malaysian food is so complex. Finally, in Penang, the undisputed food capital of the country and where her family story began, Rachel discovers why Malaysia is a great place to be young, female and Muslim. As she unpacks the multicultural culinary history of Malaysia, Rachel reveals layers of her own family history and gains a more profound understanding of what it means to be Malaysian.

programme.title: Meet Me in St Louis
programme.desc: Vincente Minnelli's colourful MGM musical about the everyday adventures and romantic entanglements of the Smith family in St Louis, starring Judy Garland. Among the memorable tunes are The Boy Next Door, The Trolley Song, Have Yourself a Merry Little Christmas and, of course, the title song.

programme.title: Fake or Fortune?
programme.desc: The last gift left in the will of a former Kindertransport child is thought to be by Fauvist artist Derain. Will it raise a small fortune for charity or prove a dastardly forgery?

programme.title: Evolution
programme.desc: How did the bat get so hungry? Chris Packham sets out to answer a deceptively simple question: how the drive to find food shaped life on earth and gave rise to one of nature’s most insatiable feeders. This is the story of the origin of bums, guts, jaws and super hearing, and a 500-million-year chain of innovation, survival and hunger.

programme.title: Superman
programme.desc: Before his planet is destroyed, Jor-El sends his infant son to Earth. Raised by kindly farmers, a young Clark Kent discovers the source of his superhuman powers and moves to Metropolis to fight evil.

programme.title: BBC Proms
programme.desc: Nick Mohammed presents the Proms debut of the Spanish National Orchestra from the Royal Albert Hall. Under chief conductor David Afkham, the orchestra performs music inspired by Spain, from Ravel's mesmerising Boléro, evoking the Spanish dance of the same name, to Rodrigo's beloved Concierto de Aranjuez, which depicts the royal gardens south of Madrid, with acclaimed Spanish guitarist Rafael Aguirre as soloist. The concert also features the sun-drenched dances of Manuel de Falla's The Three-Cornered Hat, capturing the heat and vibrant dance rhythms of Andalusia. Nick is joined by Strictly Come Dancing star Janette Manrara to celebrate the Latin dance rhythms that run through the evening's music.

programme.title: Barbra Streisand: Becoming an Icon 1942-1984
programme.desc: Barbra Streisand grew up in working-class Brooklyn, dreaming of escape from her tough childhood. A stellar student, she resisted the pressure to go to college as her sights were firmly set on Broadway. She was determined to become an actress and landed her first role aged 16, but it was two years later, when she started to sing, that her career took off. Subverting stereotypes and breaking glass ceilings, this programme looks at her rise to stardom and the remarkable achievements of her early career.

programme.title: A Star Is Born
programme.desc: A self-destructive rock star falls in love with an aspiring singer, but their passionate romance turns tragic as her meteoric rise to fame coincides with his downward spiral into addiction.

programme.title: Golf: Women's Open
programme.desc: Highlights from the third day of the Women’s Open at Royal Lytham & St Annes. England’s Georgia Hall secured a famous victory when the championship was last played on the Lancashire links in 2018. South Korea’s Haeran Ryu begins the week going for a third consecutive major victory, while American world number one Nelly Korda is also looking to make it three major wins this season. Japan’s Miyu Yamashita is the defending champion following an impressive victory at Royal Porthcawl in 2025.

The concert also features the sun-drenched dances of Manuel de Falla's The Three-Cornered Hat, capturing the heat and vibrant dance rhythms of Andalusia. Nick is joined by Strictly Come Dancing star Janette Manrara to celebrate the Latin dance rhythms that run through the evening's music.

programme.title: Barbra Streisand: Becoming an Icon 1942-1984
programme.desc: Barbra Streisand grew up in working-class Brooklyn, dreaming of escape from her tough childhood. She was determined to become an actress and landed her first role aged 16, but it was two years later, when she started to sing, that her career took off. programme.title: A Star Is Born

programme.title: Golf: Women's Open

programme.title: Newsround
programme.desc: Topical news magazine for children.

programme.title: The Lady Grace Mysteries
programme.desc: When the Crown of St Benedict is stolen from a locked and guarded room in the court of Queen Elizabeth I, Lady Grace sets out to solve the mystery!

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: As summer reaches its peak, Monty plans ahead, and after weeks of soaring temperatures, he’s got his work cut out refreshing the borders with a selection of late-summer perennials. He also has a rambling rose to tackle, and in the veg garden, the cleared beds are quickly being re-sown with crops for future harvests. Thirty years after the death of gardening legend Geoff Hamilton, Adam Frost makes a deeply personal visit to Barnsdale and reflects on the man whose huge influence helped shape both his career and love of horticulture. Carol Klein continues her fascinating journey into the secret life of plants. Exploring cutting-edge science, she discovers how vast networks of underground microbes work in partnership with plant roots, revealing the extraordinary hidden world beneath the earth. There’s an award-winning grower whose passion for gladioli has led to a collection of more than 1,800 spectacular blooms. Plus a visit to a remarkable Balinese-inspired tropical paradise nestled on the edge of the Brecon Beacons.

programme.title: On the Waterfront
programme.desc: Oscar-winning drama. A one-time boxing hopeful learns about responsibility through his love for the sister of a murdered docker. Music by Leonard Bernstein.

programme.title: The Great British Sewing Bee
programme.desc: It’s week 3, and it's time for Reduce, Reuse, Recycle. Presenter Sophie Willan, alongside judges Patrick Grant and Esme Young, takes the fight to fast fashion with three challenges focused on the environment and sustainability. First up, in the Pattern Challenge, it’s another sewing bee first as the sewers are tasked with creating pants from old T-shirts. However, they are not asked to make just one pair - they have to make three. This challenge tests not only their technical skill but also their consistency. Then, Patrick and Esme take a trip to a store of waste destined for landfill to hand-pick the raw materials for the Transformation Challenge. Finally, the sewers get protesting as they make outfits with an environmental message made to measure their models.

programme.title: A Cook Abroad
programme.desc: Cook and food writer Rachel Khoo heads to Malaysia, home of her extended family, to explore one of the world's most exciting cuisines. From the tropical shores of a remote fishing village to a foraged feast deep in the jungle, Rachel travels across this multicultural country to find out whether good food can unite a nation. On this journey of discovery Rachel delves deep into her own family heritage. Starting in the country's capital, Kuala Lumpur, she gets her first insights into Malaysian food and culture from family members she hasn't seen since childhood. In her dad's old school she meets cooks and students and begins to find out why Malaysian food is so complex. Finally, in Penang, the undisputed food capital of the country and where her family story began, Rachel discovers why Malaysia is a great place to be young, female and Muslim. As she unpacks the multicultural culinary history of Malaysia, Rachel reveals layers of her own family history and gains a more profound understanding of what it means to be Malaysian.

programme.title: Bing
programme.desc: Bing and Sula find a helium balloon stuck in a tree in the park. programme.title: Bing
programme.desc: Bing and Sula are planting seeds at Amma's when Coco arrives with her new skipping rope. Coco teaches them how to skip, with Sula picking it up quicker than Bing. Just when Bing thinks he has succeeded, he hurts his leg on the watering can! Bing can't understand why he is not as good as Sula, but Coco shows Bing that, with some help, he can learn to skip too!

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: It's a very hot day and Duggee's flowers are looking very sad. What can perk them up? Some water of course, but there's not a drop to be found. Duggee teaches the Squirrels the best rain dance ever and it really does work well. Now they can all do their crazy dancing in the rain!

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: Norrie is upset when she sees a leaf fall from the tree. She thinks it's broken. She soon cheers up when she finds out that some trees shed their leaves in autumn, and actually it's quite good fun playing and jumping in piles of leaves. But ouch! What has Roly found stuck to his bottom? It's an acorn. Duggee explains that lots of forest animals collect acorns to eat in the winter, so the Squirrels decide to look and find lots of acorns to share out for everyone.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Dad retells the story of the three little pigs.

programme.title: Go Jetters
programme.desc: Meet the Go Jetters, four explorers on a global adventure! In this animated adventure comedy series, plucky heroes Xuli, Kyan, Lars and Foz travel the world with their teacher Ubercorn - a disco-loving unicorn. When the Grandmaster Glitch's TV aerial breaks, he orders the Grimbots to take Lars's favourite landmark, the Eiffel Tower, and bolt it onto the top of Grim HQ instead. However, just as Grandmaster Glitch settles down to watch his favourite TV show, Hospital for Broken Hearts, the weight of the magnificent iron structure tips Grim HQ over and it plummets top-first into the ground. Whilst the Grimbots and Grandmaster Glitch do their best to stop them, the Go Jetters use their click-ons to release the Eiffel Tower from Grim HQ and get the famous Parisian landmark back into position.

programme.title: Octonauts

programme.title: Rafi the Wishing Wizard

programme.title: Knee High Spies
programme.desc: Pranksy traps Deena in her box, so Jeremy and Squash crash a birthday party to save her.

programme.title: The Weasy Family
programme.desc: The ducklings find a jigsaw puzzle and can't wait to put it together. But the attic is such a mess that there's no room left to play! Luckily, Spicy has spotted a sorting robot in the Farm of the Future.

programme.title: Talking Tom Heroes: Suddenly Super
programme.desc: Becca helps the Heroes when they battle a giant monster made of rubbish.

programme.title: Small Potatoes
programme.desc: Animated series about a group of potatoes who sing songs in different genres. In this doo-wop number, the potatoes dress up in special ways. They get ready for a party and try on silly costumes.

programme.title: Monster Makes
programme.desc: Rebecca and Murphi are playing hide-and-seek. Murphi is so difficult to find that he comes out of hiding to help Rebecca make a cardboard tube tracker dog. The Mini Monsters make paper bag monsters, and Rebecca’s Grandpa calls to share his fishing frustrations. The Recycling Express brings a shoebox, inspiring a mega monster idea - a magnificent monster! And the Tiny Helpers are on hand to help make the hutch.

programme.title: My World Kitchen
programme.desc: Charlotte's dad is Irish and he has shown Charlotte how to make Irish boxty for her friends. Ireland is an interesting place, and we learn all about it as Charlotte cooks her meal. She uses mashed and grated potatoes to make her boxty, and she flavours the potato mixture with lots of delicious ingredients including fresh rosemary. Charlotte thinks that rosemary smells like fresh air but some of her friends are not so keen and don't really like the taste of rosemary on its own. Charlotte tops her boxty with a cooked egg and serves it alongside some sliced tomatoes. She hopes her friends will really like it.

programme.title: Hamza Loves Animals: Africa
programme.desc: Kipekee the elephant has fun as she discovers the talents of the other animals. Hamza sees some oryx in the wild and spends time with the baby zebras at the orphanage.

programme.title: Down on the Farm
programme.desc: Storm helps pick lavender on a farm in Somerset and finds out how they make lavender oil, while JB discovers how pigs keep cool in the hot summer weather. We visit a festival in Herefordshire to see lots of funny scarecrows, Storm shares a poem about summer picnics and we learn how blackcurrants are made into juice drinks.

programme.title: Waffle the Wonder Dog
programme.desc: Waffle is an adorable talking dog who can't help but cause trouble! His everyday adventures are full of mayhem and mischief. Warning: theme tune guaranteed to stick in your head.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: A big box is delivered to the Clubhouse, and the Squirrels are very excited. What could be inside? Oh! It is a huge box of bits and pieces. Duggee and the Squirrels are going to have to work very hard to put it all together. Time for a bit of teamwork.

programme.title: Octonauts
programme.desc: Join an adventurous team of underwater explorers as they dive into action, rescuing all sorts of amazing sea creatures and trying their best to protect the ocean.

programme.title: Vida the Vet
programme.desc: It’s Healthy Fur Day, and all the animals in Sweetwood are coming to Vida’s clinic to get groomed - except Zigzag, a bunny with some serious knots in her fluffy tail.

programme.title: Go Jetters
programme.desc: Glitch is in New York to see a Broadway show but can't find anywhere to leave the Grimbler. Then he stumbles on Central Park and decides to build his own car park there. Meanwhile, the Go Jetters drop Kyan off nearby so he can practise his fantastic gymnastics in the park. Kyan discovers a queue of cars making their way across the grass, with a Grimbot traffic warden directing them towards a huge Grim car park. He tries to stop them, but the Grimbots attempt to shrink him with their size ray. As Xuli, Lars and Foz enjoy the view from the Statue of Liberty, they spot a blanket of smog covering the New York skyline. Xuli calls Kyan to find out what's going on, and Kyan explains that Glitch's car park is causing the smog to build. Ubercorn sends Lars and Foz to suck up the smog, and Foz uses the size ray to shrink the car park.

programme.title: Big Lizard
programme.desc: Cosima, Big Lizard and Ammon are squabbling over Dad's precious explorer notebook when disaster strikes. Only by working together can they save it from being lost forever!

programme.title: Yukee
programme.desc: Stripes has written a brilliant song, but his guitar string is broken, so he can't play it. Yukee decides to surprise Stripes by enlisting his garden friends to sing the song to him. The trouble is, they can’t find the right pitch to sing the song in!

programme.title: Froglets
programme.desc: With a bit of Froggie help, Pipp turns into a queen with a crown, a throne and a royal parade.

programme.title: Something Special
programme.desc: Justin meets Rheagan on the slopes to take part in her skiing lesson. George joins in the snowy fun too! Meanwhile, Mr Tumble helps Tumble Ted get ready for a big adventure of his own. There's snowy activity in the spotty surprise. Featuring signs for the words coat, helmet and ski slope.

programme.title: Dog Squad
programme.desc: Hearing dog Diesel is off to the beach with his owner Rayane so he can try out the new metal detector he got for his birthday. Rayane is deaf, which means he doesn’t hear everything, and Diesel’s super ears are trained to alert him to important sounds he might miss. Diesel is Rayane’s ears! Rayane and Diesel have been practising with the metal detector in the garden. At the beach, Diesel helps Mum find the perfect spot for a picnic. Rayane and Diesel head off with their metal detector in search of some treasure. They find a harmonica, a spoon, some coins, a metal clip... and a set of car keys. They head back up the beach to find Mum, and together they set off to reunite the missing car keys with their owner. Can Diesel’s super ears save the day again?

programme.title: Football Fantastics
programme.desc: Taran wants to play football with his dad. Rajinder gives him newly invented training boots instead of playing, until he realises Taran only wants a simple kickabout.

programme.title: Zog
programme.desc: Zog starts sleepwalking, wreaking havoc in the forest. Pearl and Gadabout need to work together to help him, but they can’t seem to put their personal disagreements aside.

programme.title: Vegesaurs
programme.desc: Stuck in a cave during heavy rain, Ginger and the Peas have fun playing indoors for once.

programme.title: Go Wild
programme.desc: Steve and Aneeshwar meet a group of meerkats who are busy digging through the soil, looking for something to eat. Next, they go to see some giant millipedes to see if they can count their legs. They discover the connection between these two animals, who don’t look like they have anything in common at all.

programme.title: Roots and Fruits
programme.desc: Live from the Roots and Fruits theatre, it’s Grapefruit dedicating the song All My Friends to the close pals who go with her everywhere.

programme.title: Tish Tash
programme.desc: The family are stuck in a traffic jam on their way to the seaside and tempers are fraying. Tish is eager to lighten the mood and imagines the car is a submarine, and Tish and Tash explore the ocean. All is well until they come across a giant whale that eats them up. But after a few tickles, the whale lets them go, and they are freed! As we return to the real world, the family car drives out of the ferry, having made it on holiday in one piece and in peace.

programme.title: Puffin Rock
programme.desc: Marvin is having a bad, bad day - he has lost his favourite rock. Oona helps him look for another rock, but all the new ones are too small, too heavy or too pointy. It seems like no other rock will do until Oona spots the seagulls with Marvin's old rock. She comes up with a plan to help him get it back!

programme.title: Love Monster
programme.desc: Love Monster's pineapple costume makes it hard for him to take part in any party events.

programme.title: Numberblocks
programme.desc: When Numberblock One opens a fix-it shop, her friends bring broken things that need to be repaired. Using her special goggles, One works out how many missing parts they require from the boxes of bits and pieces in her workshop. How many parts does Two need to make one whole sledge? And what about Three’s rocket? Once they have found everything, One uses her brand new magical workbench to put the pieces together to make the toys whole.

programme.title: Colourblocks
programme.desc: Black and White colour a city with new the help of new friend Grey. Learn to mix different shades of grey with the Colourblocks.

programme.title: Froglets
programme.desc: Ziff, Pipp and Button make a clever telescope and enjoy a magical star-filled adventure.

programme.title: Playtime Towers
programme.desc: Bella and Lift have fun playing with paper plates, just like Sketch in Boxtropolis, who makes paper plate mega monster masks.

programme.title: Yukee
programme.desc: Stripes has borrowed Twinkle's xylophone, but he has lost it - and right before her performance! The gang race around the garden, listening for clues. But will they find it in time?

programme.title: Tiny Tunes
programme.desc: Lisa and the children craft paper sheep, learn British Sign Language signs for sheep, where and home, then sing and sign Little Bo Peep Has Lost Her Sheep.

programme.title: Nick Cope's Popcast
programme.desc: Nick creates a Popcast song about a brave penguin called Ruby, who was born with one wing.

programme.title: Piripenguins
programme.desc: When Millie the Squid devises a set of tough penguin games to test the Piripenguins, Pancake and Nugget must stick together and rely on their friendship to succeed.

programme.title: Zog
programme.desc: When Mara calls Pearl sensible, she wants to prove how fun she is. With her eye off the ball, Pearl starts to make medical mistakes. Can she be a fun doctor?

programme.title: Rafi the Wishing Wizard
programme.desc: Rafi, Ruby and Finn struggle to score in basketball, so Rafi wishes for a magic ball. At first, it’s fun, as every shot goes in - even trick throws. But the constant winning becomes boring, and the ball bounces endlessly into the hoop by itself. The trio try to contain it, but it escapes again and again. Finally, they return to playing with the ordinary ball, and Finn sinks a real shot, proving true victory is earned.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Bluey and Bingo are playing the quiet game so won't tell Dad which toy to buy for Muffin.

programme.title: Nikhil & Jay
programme.desc: When Nikhil and Jay hear Amma and Appa talking about a star birthday, they try to find out what it is. Through a misunderstanding, they make it a star birthday to remember!

programme.title: Sarah & Duck
programme.desc: Duck wins a trip for two to a rather exciting hotel and finds that he settles in much quicker than Sarah.

programme.title: Charlie and Lola
programme.desc: Charlie and Marv must come up with an invention for a school project by tomorrow. Lola reckons that she's an extremely good inventor too and keeps interrupting their efforts with ideas of her own. The boys must invent something really fantastic, and time is running out. Just as they are beginning to panic, Lola the Inventor stumbles on a brilliant idea.

programme.title: Moon and Me
programme.desc: In the Toy House kitchen, Mr Onion and Pepi Nana find the little toy tub. Little Nana wishes that the little toy tub was a great big tub. In Storyland, everybody enjoys a Rub-a-dub-dub song with the great big tub.

programme.title: BeddyByes
programme.desc: MeMo and BaBa have fun spotting the Yummies, who are popping up all over BeddyByes. At Play Time, the Yummies pop up and disappear again whilst MeMo and BaBa play with a beepy horn. They take it to Yummy Land, where the Yummies explain that they are looking everywhere for Yummy Dog. MeMo and BaBa help to look, beeping the horn as they go. Yummy Dog hears the horn and is reunited with the Yummies.

programme.desc: Tombliboo Eee becomes separated from the other two Tombliboos, Unn and Ooo. They wander all over the garden looking for each other until Tombliboo Eee meets Upsy Daisy, who calls for the others with her megaphone.

programme.desc: A story read by a special guest. George Ezra reads a Bedtime Story about a little owl who goes on a magical, shooting star-filled journey.

programme.desc: The ducklings find a jigsaw puzzle and can't wait to put it together. But the attic is such a mess that there's no room left to play! Luckily, Spicy has spotted a sorting robot in the Farm of the Future.

programme.title: Talking Tom Heroes: Suddenly Super
programme.desc: Becca helps the Heroes when they battle a giant monster made of rubbish.

programme.title: Small Potatoes
programme.desc: Animated series about a group of potatoes who sing songs in different genres. In this doo-wop number, the potatoes dress up in special ways. They get ready for a party and try on silly costumes.

programme.title: Monster Makes
programme.desc: Rebecca and Murphi are playing hide-and-seek. Murphi is so difficult to find that he comes out of hiding to help Rebecca make a cardboard tube tracker dog. The Mini Monsters make paper bag monsters, and Rebecca’s Grandpa calls to share his fishing frustrations. The Recycling Express brings a shoebox, inspiring a mega monster idea - a magnificent monster! And the Tiny Helpers are on hand to help make the hutch.

programme.title: My World Kitchen
programme.desc: Charlotte's dad is Irish and he has shown Charlotte how to make Irish boxty for her friends. Ireland is an interesting place, and we learn all about it as Charlotte cooks her meal. She uses mashed and grated potatoes to make her boxty, and she flavours the potato mixture with lots of delicious ingredients including fresh rosemary. Charlotte thinks that rosemary smells like fresh air but some of her friends are not so keen and don't really like the taste of rosemary on its own. Charlotte tops her boxty with a cooked egg and serves it alongside some sliced tomatoes. She hopes her friends will really like it.

programme.title: Hamza Loves Animals: Africa
programme.desc: Kipekee the elephant has fun as she discovers the talents of the other animals. Hamza sees some oryx in the wild and spends time with the baby zebras at the orphanage.

programme.title: Down on the Farm
programme.desc: Storm helps pick lavender on a farm in Somerset and finds out how they make lavender oil, while JB discovers how pigs keep cool in the hot summer weather. We visit a festival in Herefordshire to see lots of funny scarecrows, Storm shares a poem about summer picnics and we learn how blackcurrants are made into juice drinks.

programme.title: Waffle the Wonder Dog
programme.desc: Waffle is an adorable talking dog who can't help but cause trouble! His everyday adventures are full of mayhem and mischief. Warning: theme tune guaranteed to stick in your head.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: A big box is delivered to the Clubhouse, and the Squirrels are very excited. What could be inside? Oh! It is a huge box of bits and pieces. Duggee and the Squirrels are going to have to work very hard to put it all together. Time for a bit of teamwork.

programme.title: Octonauts
programme.desc: Join an adventurous team of underwater explorers as they dive into action, rescuing all sorts of amazing sea creatures and trying their best to protect the ocean.

programme.title: Vida the Vet
programme.desc: It’s Healthy Fur Day, and all the animals in Sweetwood are coming to Vida’s clinic to get groomed - except Zigzag, a bunny with some serious knots in her fluffy tail.

programme.title: Go Jetters
programme.desc: Glitch is in New York to see a Broadway show but can't find anywhere to leave the Grimbler. Then he stumbles on Central Park and decides to build his own car park there. Meanwhile, the Go Jetters drop Kyan off nearby so he can practise his fantastic gymnastics in the park. Kyan discovers a queue of cars making their way across the grass, with a Grimbot traffic warden directing them towards a huge Grim car park. He tries to stop them, but the Grimbots attempt to shrink him with their size ray. As Xuli, Lars and Foz enjoy the view from the Statue of Liberty, they spot a blanket of smog covering the New York skyline. Xuli calls Kyan to find out what's going on, and Kyan explains that Glitch's car park is causing the smog to build. Ubercorn sends Lars and Foz to suck up the smog, and Foz uses the size ray to shrink the car park.

programme.title: Big Lizard
programme.desc: Cosima, Big Lizard and Ammon are squabbling over Dad's precious explorer notebook when disaster strikes. Only by working together can they save it from being lost forever!

programme.title: Yukee
programme.desc: Stripes has written a brilliant song, but his guitar string is broken, so he can't play it. Yukee decides to surprise Stripes by enlisting his garden friends to sing the song to him. The trouble is, they can’t find the right pitch to sing the song in!

programme.title: Froglets
programme.desc: With a bit of Froggie help, Pipp turns into a queen with a crown, a throne and a royal parade.

programme.title: Something Special
programme.desc: Justin meets Rheagan on the slopes to take part in her skiing lesson. George joins in the snowy fun too! Meanwhile, Mr Tumble helps Tumble Ted get ready for a big adventure of his own. There's snowy activity in the spotty surprise. Featuring signs for the words coat, helmet and ski slope.

programme.title: Dog Squad
programme.desc: Hearing dog Diesel is off to the beach with his owner Rayane so he can try out the new metal detector he got for his birthday. Rayane is deaf, which means he doesn’t hear everything, and Diesel’s super ears are trained to alert him to important sounds he might miss. Diesel is Rayane’s ears! Rayane and Diesel have been practising with the metal detector in the garden. At the beach, Diesel helps Mum find the perfect spot for a picnic. Rayane and Diesel head off with their metal detector in search of some treasure. They find a harmonica, a spoon, some coins, a metal clip... and a set of car keys. They head back up the beach to find Mum, and together they set off to reunite the missing car keys with their owner. Can Diesel’s super ears save the day again?

programme.title: Football Fantastics
programme.desc: Taran wants to play football with his dad. Rajinder gives him newly invented training boots instead of playing, until he realises Taran only wants a simple kickabout.

programme.title: Zog
programme.desc: Zog starts sleepwalking, wreaking havoc in the forest. Pearl and Gadabout need to work together to help him, but they can’t seem to put their personal disagreements aside.

programme.title: Vegesaurs
programme.desc: Stuck in a cave during heavy rain, Ginger and the Peas have fun playing indoors for once.

programme.title: Go Wild
programme.desc: Steve and Aneeshwar meet a group of meerkats who are busy digging through the soil, looking for something to eat. Next, they go to see some giant millipedes to see if they can count their legs. They discover the connection between these two animals, who don’t look like they have anything in common at all.

programme.title: Roots and Fruits
programme.desc: Live from the Roots and Fruits theatre, it’s Grapefruit dedicating the song All My Friends to the close pals who go with her everywhere.

programme.title: Tish Tash
programme.desc: The family are stuck in a traffic jam on their way to the seaside and tempers are fraying. Tish is eager to lighten the mood and imagines the car is a submarine, and Tish and Tash explore the ocean. All is well until they come across a giant whale that eats them up. But after a few tickles, the whale lets them go, and they are freed! As we return to the real world, the family car drives out of the ferry, having made it on holiday in one piece and in peace.

programme.title: Puffin Rock
programme.desc: Marvin is having a bad, bad day - he has lost his favourite rock. Oona helps him look for another rock, but all the new ones are too small, too heavy or too pointy. It seems like no other rock will do until Oona spots the seagulls with Marvin's old rock. She comes up with a plan to help him get it back!

programme.title: Love Monster

Using her special goggles, One works out how many missing parts they require from the boxes of bits and pieces in her workshop. How many parts does Two need to make one whole sledge? And what about Three’s rocket? Once they have found everything, One uses her brand new magical workbench to put the pieces together to make the toys whole.

programme.title: Force Of Nature
programme.desc: Documentary series revealing the incredible ways in which all life is impacted by our journey around the Sun. As climate change accelerates, weather across the planet is becoming more extreme, more violent, and less predictable - a burrowing owl mother on the American prairies must use her extraordinary hearing and a network of underground burrows to save her scattered chicks from intensifying tornadoes, two veteran cheetah brothers in Kenya face record-breaking floods that force them to swim raging rivers and confront deadly rivals before one hunting alone uses the storms to his advantage, a young polar bear in the Arctic loses the summer sea ice she depends on and is driven to stalk reindeer on land, and a troop of chimpanzees in drought-stricken Senegal dig wells and descend into abandoned gold mines in a desperate search for water. These animals across a warming world reveal resilience, ingenuity and courage, but adaptation has limits in the face of relentless change.

The Food Hero this time is a social enterprise from Swansea called The Shared Plate where a chop and chat is good for the soul - John then heads to the local flower farm and creates a wonderful arrangement with the help of gardener Philippa before Prue shares her hacks for peeling tomatoes and making overnight oats.

programme.title: James Martin's American Adventure
programme.desc: A trip to California wouldn't be complete without a visit to the famous vineyards of Sonoma County, so James continues his American adventure with a drive on his much-loved Harley Davidson to visit a unique winery and farm where he cooks two beautiful dishes using local ingredients - James also visits Single Thread, a farm and restaurant run by a passionate husband-and-wife team where he is totally overwhelmed by the culinary offerings. James's adventure isn't just about food, however, as he also visits a Tibetan artist who is undertaking a breathtaking five-year-long ceremonial painting in a truly magical experience.

programme.title: Love Your Weekend with Alan Titchmarsh
programme.desc: Alan is joined at Manor Farm this time by legendary singer Petula Clark - who talks about her illustrious career - Midsomer Murders' Fiona Dolman, who chats about keeping DCI John Barnaby in check, and former NHS doctor-turned-comedian and author Adam Kaye, who talks about the power of laughter. Alan will also be taking a look the ancient art of horseback falconry and celebrating the very best in British chardonnay this time.

programme.title: James Martin's Saturday Morning
programme.desc: James is joined at his house in the Hampshire countryside by presenter, DJ and I'm a Celebrity... Get Me Out of Here! star Kelly Brook, chefs Tommy Banks and Alex Dilling, and forager Alysia Vasey.

programme.title: Prue Leith's Cotswold Kitchen
programme.desc: Prue Leith, her husband and friends cook more mouth-watering dishes and explore the joys of their Cotswold home and local area - Prue is joined in her kitchen in this episode of the programme by Lulu, who she first met at her restaurant in the 1970s. After Lulu bursts into song while the two are making a chocolate puddle cake reminiscent of the meal she ate at Prue's restaurant all those years ago, Prue cooks up one of her favourite suppers of peri-peri chicken with butter beans and broccoli agrodolce - when John joins her in the kitchen, it's a 'poshed-up' version of haggis with neaps and tatties that's on the menu. The Food Hero this time is a social enterprise from Swansea called The Shared Plate where a chop and chat is good for the soul - John then heads to the local flower farm and creates a wonderful arrangement with the help of gardener Philippa before Prue shares her hacks for peeling tomatoes and making overnight oats.

programme.title: Force Of Nature
programme.desc: Documentary series revealing the incredible ways in which all life is impacted by our journey around the Sun. As climate change accelerates, weather across the planet is becoming more extreme, more violent, and less predictable - a burrowing owl mother on the American prairies must use her extraordinary hearing and a network of underground burrows to save her scattered chicks from intensifying tornadoes, two veteran cheetah brothers in Kenya face record-breaking floods that force them to swim raging rivers and confront deadly rivals before one hunting alone uses the storms to his advantage, a young polar bear in the Arctic loses the summer sea ice she depends on and is driven to stalk reindeer on land, and a troop of chimpanzees in drought-stricken Senegal dig wells and descend into abandoned gold mines in a desperate search for water. These animals across a warming world reveal resilience, ingenuity and courage, but adaptation has limits in the face of relentless change.

programme.title: Prue Leith's Cotswold Kitchen
programme.desc: Prue Leith, her husband and friends cook more mouth-watering dishes and explore the joys of their Cotswold home and local area - Prue is joined in her kitchen in this episode of the programme by Lulu, who she first met at her restaurant in the 1970s. After Lulu bursts into song while the two are making a chocolate puddle cake reminiscent of the meal she ate at Prue's restaurant all those years ago, Prue cooks up one of her favourite suppers of peri-peri chicken with butter beans and broccoli agrodolce - when John joins her in the kitchen, it's a 'poshed-up' version of haggis with neaps and tatties that's on the menu. The Food Hero this time is a social enterprise from Swansea called The Shared Plate where a chop and chat is good for the soul - John then heads to the local flower farm and creates a wonderful arrangement with the help of gardener Philippa before Prue shares her hacks for peeling tomatoes and making overnight oats.

As the peaceful setting of the prestigious club is rocked by death and controversy when a golfer is bludgeoned to death near the notorious 13th hole known as Crisp's Folly, Barnaby and Jones learn that crime is rife there...

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Barnaby's secret past as a British agent comes back to haunt him after a grisly murder in Midsomer Parva. A pleasant afternoon at a cricket match turns ugly when former county-cricketer - and ex-spy - Geoffrey Larkin is found gashed to death. Locals blame the 'beast of Midsomer', but Barnaby is unconvinced, especially when he discovers that umpire and retired spymaster Malcolm Frazer is using his home, Allenby House, as a safe house. Soon Barnaby discovers links to a spy ring that operated in Berlin during the Cold War, but his investigation is obstructed at every turn, and it seems as though shady dealings are still going on at Allenby House. Then there is another murder - can Barnaby solve the crime before any people get hurt? And will his police career survive a run-in with MI6? Guest starring Peter Davison, Alice Krige and Anna Massey.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: When octogenarian Felicity Law puts a recently discovered piece by local landscape artist Henry Hogson up for auction, the painting causes a fierce bidding war. But soon after the sale, Felicity is found tortured and killed. She had announced that she would give the proceeds of the sale to the Arnold Simms School of Art, a school that helps criminals and which had recently lost its funding. Barnaby enlists Simms' art teacher daughter Matilda to help him navigate the local art world. He soon finds many tangled relationships between teachers, dealers and buyers. Things get more complicated when a Hogson masterpiece is stolen and Matilda's former lover Graham Spate offers another Hogson to greedy art dealer Anthony Prideaux. Then the death count begins to rise. The key to the case seems to be Matilda's 'little black book' - but can Barnaby and Jones find the book and catch the killer before anyone else gets hurt?

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Midsomer University clashes with big business when science fellow George Jeffers threatens to go public with what he believes is a potentially lethal software glitch in a new air traffic control system. American software boss Clinton Finn fears he will lose millions if the truth comes out and puts pressure on the University authorities. But when village schoolteacher Emily Harte is killed by a hit-and-run driver, Barnaby wonders if Jeffers was the real target.

programme.title: Vera

DCI Vera Stanhope and her team investigate the mysterious death of an unidentified man who is found floating in the slurry pit of a remote Northumberland farm - as owner Danny Pryor is forced to admit that he uses a number of illegal Serbian workers, a faded tattoo identifies the victim as Jack Reeves, a young man from the local travelling community. His father Billy Reeves insists that he has not seen his son since he broke off his engagement to teenager Sigourney O'Brien, but would her father Frank go as far as murder to avenge the honour of his daughter? After an old police report links Jack to a fight in a pub owned by Danny Pryor's brother Robert and exposes the real reason Jack broke off his wedding to Sigourney - he had been hiding out for months in a mobile home on woodland close to Pryor Farm - fingerprints then reveal that someone else has been inside the caravan...

programme.title: Force Of Nature
programme.desc: Documentary series revealing the incredible ways in which all life is impacted by our journey around the Sun. As climate change accelerates, weather across the planet is becoming more extreme, more violent, and less predictable - a burrowing owl mother on the American prairies must use her extraordinary hearing and a network of underground burrows to save her scattered chicks from intensifying tornadoes, two veteran cheetah brothers in Kenya face record-breaking floods that force them to swim raging rivers and confront deadly rivals before one hunting alone uses the storms to his advantage, a young polar bear in the Arctic loses the summer sea ice she depends on and is driven to stalk reindeer on land, and a troop of chimpanzees in drought-stricken Senegal dig wells and descend into abandoned gold mines in a desperate search for water. These animals across a warming world reveal resilience, ingenuity and courage, but adaptation has limits in the face of relentless change.
